issues.explanation: The adaptation says Meng Da was killed by Sima Yi, but the source specifies that Sima Yi besieged the city and Meng Da was stabbed and beheaded by Shen Dan after Shen Dan and Shen Yi turned against him.
issues.suggested_fix: Change the wording to say that Shen Dan and Shen Yi betrayed Meng Da, and Shen Dan killed him while he fled.
